candidate_sentences.text: For the financial year 2025, the Group reported total revenue of approximately 1.837 billion euros compared to 1.372 billion euros in the previous year.
Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA) amounted to 227.919 million euros, compared to 145.275 million euros in 2024, representing an EBITDA margin of 12.4%.

Net profit for the financial year was 69.857 million euros, of which 70.550 million euros was attributable to the owners of the parent company, reflecting a decrease from the 2024 net profit of 193.670 million euros, which was heavily influenced by one-off gains from the initial consolidation of Tallink Grupp recognized in the previous period.
Total assets at the end of 2025 were 2.597 billion euros, down slightly from 2.715 billion euros at the end of 2024, while total equity increased to 1.175 billion euros from 1.166 billion euros.

verified_key_information_units.information: The revenue and EBITDA growth was primarily driven by the full-year consolidation of Tallink Grupp (acquired in August 2024), improved performance at Elenger Grupp, and contributions from newly consolidated agriculture assets including Estonia Farmid and Halinga.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures of 2025 commentary, Events in 2025 (Tallink, Energy, Agriculture sections)

candidate_sentences.text: The financial results were significantly influenced by the full twelve-month consolidation of AS Tallink Grupp following the acquisition of a controlling stake in August 2024, alongside expansion in the energy sector through Elenger Grupp and acquisitions in the agricultural sector, notably Estonia Farmid OÜ.

verified_key_information_units.information: The maritime transport segment carried 5.53 million passengers (0.9% decrease YoY), with cargo units down 19.2% to 245,004 and passenger vehicles down 2.2% to 760,473. Vessel chartering balanced seasonal revenue fluctuations, and technical upgrades focused on reducing CO₂ emissions.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in 2025 - Maritime transport business segment

verified_key_information_units.information: The energy segment delivered 18 TWh of LNG to Inkoo and Klaipėda terminals (unchanged YoY) with a market share of approximately 25% in the Finnish-Baltic region. Investments included a new 4.9 MW solar plant in Latvia and an 8 MWh battery storage facility, with plans for additional storage in Estonia.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in 2025 - Energy business segment, Management Report Overview

verified_key_information_units.information: Real estate developments included completion of the 25,000 m² Rimi logistics centre in Laagri and commencement of construction for a 30,000 m² Depo DIY retail space in Lasnamäe. INF Infra secured a EUR 67.2 million contract for Rail Baltica mainline construction on the Kangru-Saku section.
Infortar acquired Estonia Farmid OÜ, gaining control of a major dairy farming and cereals operation, expanding its agriculture segment with the transaction completed on 7 July 2025.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in 2025 - Changes in Infortar's supporting sectors (agriculture acquisition details)

verified_key_information_units.information: Liquidity improved to EUR 219.8 million (from EUR 167.6 million) with loan liabilities decreasing to EUR 1.071 billion (from EUR 1.223 billion).
